description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Saga of the Beastslayer enhancement WOLF-TOUCHED (WP-S2): the bearer's unit has the WULFEN keyword and +2" M. Fixture sw11e_s2_wolves_active. Setup privileges (Command phase): P1's detachments Saga of the Beastslayer + Champions of Fenris and Wolf-Touched given to the Wolf Guard Battle Leader with its list-build half applied (as ArmyListManager does for a mustered bearer: the WULFEN keyword); then straight to the Movement phase. The Battle Leader begins a Normal move (the panel's Normal Move action): its move cap is M 7" + 2" = 9" and the movement panel shows it; the bearer can now lead the Wulfen (CharacterAttachmentManager.can_attach).

steps.script:
var u = GameState.state.units["U_WOLF_GUARD_BATTLE_LEADER_A"]
GameState.state.factions["1"]["detachment"] = "Saga of the Beastslayer"
GameState.state.factions["1"]["detachments"] = ["Saga of the Beastslayer", "Champions of Fenris"]
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
u.meta["enhancements"] = ["Wolf-Touched"]
load("res://scripts/codex/space_wolves/SWEnhancements11e.gd").apply_list_build("U_WOLF_GUARD_BATTLE_LEADER_A", u, ["Saga of the Beastslayer"])
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)
return "WULFEN" in u.meta.keywords

steps.comment: the movement panel shows the 9" cap
the bearer can lead the Wulfen (Wolf-Touched)
clean log: no ERROR line in this session's debug log
